name: Kitsune no Oto
source: This is a story of a young hunter who claims to have seen a girl one day in a forest where it is said that anyone who enters will be spirited away. The villagers all dismiss him, saying, "There's no way someone could be there, he must have been tricked by a fox". The hunter enters the forest to find out the truth. There he finds a fairy-like woman who is indistinguishable from both a human and a fox...
translation: 有一片传说踏入其中就会遭遇神隐的森林，一名年轻猎人声称某天在林中看到了一位少女。村民们全都对此不以为然，纷纷说道：“那里怎么可能有人，他肯定是让狐狸给迷住了。”为了查明真相，猎人走进了森林，并在那里发现了一名似人似狐、恍若仙女般的女子……
